items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dizzy and I used to live close to Pops... There was a whole bunch of us lived in the same area: Dizzy, me, Charlie Shavers, Jimmy Rushing, Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Helen Humes, ’Bama.

ctx.x: Rushing, Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Helen Humes, ’Bama. There was at least 15 . . .
